items.html: Now, the Keter, which took from the Ozen, its illumination is very great, and its vessel was not broken. But AVI, who take only from the Hotem and the Peh, the posterior of their vessels was broken. And behold, had Aba and Ima received this light of the Hotem and the Peh of AK while it was above, near the place of the openings of the Ozen — even though they would not have received from the lights of the Ozen itself, but only a little illumination — the posterior of their vessels would have endured. But since they receive only from the end of the Ozen, which is the place of the Shibolet of the beard, therefore, even though they take a little illumination, it does not avail them, and therefore the posterior of their vessels was broken. But the Keter, since it takes the light of the Ozen itself — even though it took it at its end, since it takes its self, this suffices, and not even the posterior of its vessels was broken. This is not so with AVI, who take only a mere illumination, and that at a remoteness of place. And thus these three discernments have been explained, namely (32) that the Keter endured in its entirety; and AVI, the posterior of theirs was broken and fell; and ZON, their anterior and their posterior both fell.
